subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Satish remained unwavering in the face of the assaulting gang, standing as resolute as _______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**steel**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**steel**" is used metaphorically to describe unwavering determination or strength. (फौलाद की तरह मजबूत)
 
• In the given sentence, "steel" fits perfectly to convey Satish's resolute and strong stance in the face of adversity.
 
• The other options: "**still**," "**stall**," and "**steal**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Still (स्थिर)**: means not moving or making a sound, which does not convey the required strength or determination in this context.
 
• **Stall (अवरोध)**: means to delay or stop progress, which is irrelevant here.
 
• **Steal (चोरी करना)**: means to take something without permission, which does not fit the sentence context.
